name: poppler-utils
description: Installs the Poppler PDF command-line tools (pdftotext, pdftoppm, pdfinfo, ...) from apt. Primary rationale is test parity: Quarto's optional PDF-text verification tests skip gracefully when pdftotext is absent, so carrying the package keeps that test path executing instead of silently skipping (upstream quarto-cli PR #13939 documents it as an optional test-only dependency, worded "pdftotext (poppler)"). Secondary rationale: general availability of the Poppler CLI suite to image users. Not a Quarto runtime component: Quarto vendors every binary it runs (DENO, DENO_DOM, PANDOC, DARTSASS, ESBUILD, TYPST, TYPST_GATHER, VERAPDF) and renders PDF preview with vendored pdf.js.

postInstallCheck.command:
marker="POPCHECK7X"
fixture_b64=""
work="$(mktemp -d)" || { echo "poppler-utils: CHECK FAIL - mktemp failed" >&2; exit 1; }
trap 'rm -rf "$work"' EXIT
if ! printf '%s' "$fixture_b64" | base64 -d > "$work/fixture.pdf" 2>/dev/null; then
  echo "poppler-utils: CHECK FAIL - embedded fixture failed to decode" >&2
  exit 1
fi
if [ ! -s "$work/fixture.pdf" ]; then
  echo "poppler-utils: CHECK FAIL - embedded fixture decoded to zero bytes" >&2
  exit 1
fi
for b in /usr/bin/pdftoppm /usr/bin/pdftotext; do
  if [ ! -x "$b" ]; then
    echo "poppler-utils: CHECK FAIL - $b missing or not executable" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
done
if ! /usr/bin/pdftoppm -png -singlefile "$work/fixture.pdf" "$work/out" 2>/dev/null; then
  echo "poppler-utils: CHECK FAIL - pdftoppm exited non-zero" >&2
  exit 1
fi
if [ ! -s "$work/out.png" ]; then
  echo "poppler-utils: CHECK FAIL - pdftoppm produced no PNG" >&2
  exit 1
fi
magic="$(od -An -tx1 -N8 "$work/out.png" | tr -d ' \n')"
if [ "$magic" != "89504e470d0a1a0a" ]; then
  echo "poppler-utils: CHECK FAIL - bad PNG magic bytes: $magic" >&2
  exit 1
fi
text="$(/usr/bin/pdftotext "$work/fixture.pdf" - 2>/dev/null)"
case "$text" in
  *"$marker"*) ;;
  *)
    echo "poppler-utils: CHECK FAIL - pdftotext did not extract marker from fixture" >&2
    exit 1
    ;;
esac
png_size="$(wc -c < "$work/out.png" | tr -d ' ')"
echo "poppler-utils: check OK (pdftoppm rendered a valid ${png_size}-byte PNG and pdftotext extracted marker POPCHECK7X from the embedded one-page fixture)"
postInstallCheck.description: Functionally verify the apt Poppler tools by rasterising an embedded one-page PDF fixture with /usr/bin/pdftoppm (PNG magic bytes validated) and extracting the marker POPCHECK7X from the same fixture with /usr/bin/pdftotext - not merely that the binaries exist
